objective: A frozen census of the 90 one-bit count laws whose board knots with the values (BARE-NAMES-20261110-001B): in a world of infinitely many copies of a frozen coloured board, and in the universal cover of one, whether for some edge {u, v} the neighbour distinction and both endpoint values are flipped in place (minimal changes of one kind of variable, not renamings; values searched within the copy, or within distance 2 in the tree). Predictions C1 (every law gets both worlds), C2 (every knot native in place in its finite-component world) and C3 (in tree worlds no value of the 31 laws with no mixed edge, nor of law 48, flips in place within distance 2).
title: Which board-value knots flip in place
